purpose: Prevent Enterprise Math research from existing durably only in the account-level GLOBAL_KNOWLEDGE journal while the project repository lacks the corresponding research frontier.

precedence.rule: This file is the narrower current authority for Enterprise Math research persistence. It overrides legacy wording that permits L1/L2/L3 research to remain REMOTE_SILENT across a semantic checkpoint or final substantive research response.

semantic_checkpoint_triggers: theorem or lemma candidate worth resuming
research direction change or closed route
final substantive research response containing new nontrivial progress

remote_silence.allowed: Only inside an unfinished below-checkpoint computation when no durable handoff is yet required.

project_artifact_rule.requirement: Persist the smallest faithful project-native artifact authorized by the active research mode and owner/promotion rules.
examples: research_returns/ or task-local result artifact when required by the task contract
owner-branch checkpoint when main promotion is not yet authorized
project_artifact_rule.canonical_truth: A persisted research artifact is provenance and durable frontier only; it is not automatically Foundation or canonical mathematical truth.

deduplicate_by: semantic equivalence to a verified current project artifact
global_knowledge_bridge.repair_rule: Before treating the parent research objective as durably checkpointed, reconcile newly captured Enterprise Math journal events against current project artifacts and persist only missing semantic content.
